events.subject_response: Couch's attorney previously said the sheriff remains fully confident in the work of his office and his ability to continue serving as sheriff, respects those who raised concerns, and intends to remain in office. CBS News Atlanta contacted Couch for an updated response and did not receive one.
events.summary: A Hall County recall group continued seeking signatures against Republican Sheriff Gerald Couch after his February DUI arrest and a second arrest involving an alleged limited-driving-permit violation; his DUI case is paused while an appellate challenge proceeds.
events.reason_for_status: CBS News Atlanta reported the current recall and appellate developments, WGTJ independently reported the same current recall effort, and Gainesville Times coverage and podcast reporting supplied additional local context and the defense response. Hall County election records explicitly identify Couch as Republican, while official Hall County and Georgia executive-order pages confirm the covered sheriff role and prior suspension. The DUI and second-arrest allegations remain unresolved; the appeal is procedural, no conviction is implied, and the recall petition has not itself removed Couch. The event is auto-publishable under the two-independent-reputable-reports-plus-response contract with medium confidence, while preserving allegation-only status.
